question.html:
A balloon rises at a steady vertical velocity of 10 ms−1. An object is released at rest relative to the balloon when the object is at a height 120 m above the ground. Air resistance is negligible.

What time, to the nearest second, does the object take to hit the ground?

  1. 4 s
  2. 5 s
  3. 6 s
  4. 12 s
